A Juicy Pear Podcast uncovers Northern Wisconsin’s eerie mysteries through real supernatural stories, strange encounters, and unforgettable guest

LOS ANGELES, CA, UNITED STATES, September 29, 2026 /EINPresswire.com/ -- Northern Wisconsin is far from ordinary. It’s a hotspot for eerie tales, spine-tingling encounters, and downright strange phenomena. A Juicy Pear Podcast with host Wendy Kok, dives headfirst into this mysterious realm, delivering electrifying stories that keep listeners hooked as they explore the dark, strange, and unexplained corners of Northern Wisconsin’s woods.

“A Juicy Pear Podcast isn’t like any other podcast out there. My guests are truly one-of-a-kind, each bringing their own supernatural story unlike anything you’ve heard before. These aren’t just typical ghost tales or urban legends; these are raw, personal experiences that challenge what we believe about the world. Every episode uncovers something fresh, unexpected, and downright fascinating, making it impossible to look away.”

The podcast is a portal into the weird and wonderful, where Bigfoot sightings, UFOs, and other supernatural legends aren’t just stories — they’re real accounts from jaw-dropping guests. “Northern Wisconsin has this eerie vibe, like the unknown is lurking just behind the trees,” Kok says. “It’s the perfect playground for strange stories that make you question reality.”

The captivating tales shared on the podcast reflect the same rich mysteries Wendy explores in her writing. Kok is also the author of A Thousand Years of Crooked Forest Series, with book one being "A Grey Resort." These chilling collections immerse readers in the haunted forests and folklore of Northern Wisconsin, blending meticulous research with firsthand accounts. Through authentic, atmospheric storytelling, Wendy brings to life eerie spirits, strange phenomena, and unexplained mysteries, offering a vivid glimpse into the supernatural world she passionately explores on her podcast.

Kok says she’s welcomed a wide variety of guests on the show, from musicians to celebrities, making A Juicy Pear Podcast an enticing listen for all audiences.

“My guests don’t just talk about urban legends, they live them,” Kok explains. “From close encounters with unexplainable creatures to night skies glowing with mysterious lights, these stories are wild, raw, and completely captivating. It’s this authenticity that powers A Juicy Pear Podcast, attracting listeners hungry for more than just ghost stories. People want real experiences, real chills—that’s why our audiences keep coming back. It’s not just entertainment; it’s about pushing the boundaries of what we understand.”

But Kok isn’t stopping there. She’s on the hunt for fresh voices and new stories that need to be heard.

“Seen something strange? Heard a whisper in the dark?" Kok concludes. "Don’t stay silent, your story could be the next episode everyone’s talking about.”

About Wendy Kok

Wendy Kok is the creator and host of A Juicy Pear Podcast and author of A Thousand Years of Crooked Forest Series. She combines a passion for the supernatural with genuine, authentic storytelling to bring audiences captivating tales from Northern Wisconsin’s mysterious and eerie world. Known for her fearless curiosity and warm, engaging style, Wendy invites listeners and readers alike to venture beyond the ordinary and explore the fascinating stories hidden beneath the surface.

To learn more or schedule an interview with Wendy Kok, please visit: https://www.ajuicypearpodcast.com/
